note: Large NPS campground on the Current River near Van Buren, in woods behind the river's gravel bars, with paved roads and spurs. Electric sites are in loop 200; loops 100 and 200 stay open in winter, when the water is off except at the heated shower house. Loop 300 has the shortest sites (21-30 ft). --Claude
